column1: # BA1/BS1 exception list for the NGS-UI ACMG rule engine (plan §5.2.4).
# Variants listed here never receive BA1 or BS1 even when common; the engine
# flags the frequency conflict instead. ClinVar >=2-star P/LP protects a
# variant only while its max AF is at most clinvar.override_max_af (5 %,
# rule v1.12); above that only this list (or a VCEP call) keeps it.
# Fill from Ghosh et al. 2018 (Hum Mutat 39:1525, Table) and in-house review;
# one variant per line, key = chrN-POS-REF-ALT (GRCh38, VCF representation).
